name: SUPRA Mission Execution Pipeline
description: Sequential and parallel stages for executing a mission through the Mission Center.

pipeline.name: Mission Intake
pipeline.description: Mission is received and validated for completeness

pipeline.name: Executive
pipeline.description: Executive receives the mission, classifies intent, decides strategy, produces high-level plan

pipeline.name: Planner
pipeline.description: Planner decomposes the mission into sub-missions with dependencies and priority

pipeline.name: Router
pipeline.description: Router selects agents, providers, and models for each sub-mission

pipeline.name: Parallel Read Agents
pipeline.description: Read agents execute in parallel. Each produces independent analysis.

pipeline.name: Comparator
pipeline.description: Comparator collects results from parallel agents and compares/ranks them

pipeline.name: Fusion
pipeline.description: Fusion merges analyses, resolves conflicts, produces unified output

pipeline.name: Validator
pipeline.description: Validator checks coherence and consistency of fused output

pipeline.name: Builder
pipeline.description: EXCLUSIVE write stage. Builder applies all mutations from the validated plan.

execution_modes.parallel: Stage 5 runs all read agents in parallel
execution_modes.conditional: Comparator, Fusion, Validator can be skipped if single-agent execution
